meta.title: The Guest with the Robot
meta.textType: story: a conversation about past events

paragraphs: On Wednesday, Tom came home at six o'clock, one hour late. Lily sat on the sofa with Pip and looked up. Tom's school bag was open, and it was full of papers. "Why are you late?" she asked. "Dinner is ready in ten minutes," called Mom from the kitchen. "We had a guest in Teacher Nick's class," said Tom. "She was a foreign visitor from another country, and she works with robots."

"What did she do?" asked Lily. "First, she took us to the new building behind the hall," said Tom. "Then we went up to the science room on the second floor." "Everybody sat in a circle around the table." "She had a small robot on the table." "It was white, and it had a small green light." "It was awesome, Lily." "It drew a picture of a tree with one long arm." "The arm moved to the left and then to the right."

"How old is she?" asked Lily. "She is young," said Tom, "and she laughs a lot." "Is she a teacher?" asked Lily. "No, she is an engineer," said Tom. "She recently came to Thailand for a school project." "She does not know our language, but she was able to talk to us in English." Pip came to Tom and put his head on Tom's bag. Tom smiled and touched the puppy's head.

"Did she say anything about her school days?" asked Lily. "Yes," said Tom. "She built her first robot when she was a teenager." "She made it from old boxes." "It was too slow, and it fell on the floor." "Was it hard?" asked Lily. "Very hard," said Tom. "She did not stop, and now she builds robots for hospitals." Lily listened and held her notebook.

"And then?" asked Lily. "After that, each of us wrote one idea for a robot," said Tom. "Ben wrote a robot that cleans the board." "Hugo wrote a robot that carries bags." "I wrote a robot that finds socks." "We stayed in the science room until half past five." "Then we helped Teacher Nick to carry the chairs." Lily laughed, and Pip made a small sound. "I want to become an engineer too," said Tom. "Come and eat, you two!" called Mom. "First, I must find my socks," he said.

sentences.text: On Wednesday, Tom came home at six o'clock, one hour late.
Lily sat on the sofa with Pip and looked up.
Tom's school bag was open, and it was full of papers.
"Why are you late?" she asked.
"Dinner is ready in ten minutes," called Mom from the kitchen.
"We had a guest in Teacher Nick's class," said Tom.
"She was a foreign visitor from another country, and she works with robots."
"What did she do?" asked Lily.
"First, she took us to the new building behind the hall," said Tom.
"Then we went up to the science room on the second floor."
"Everybody sat in a circle around the table."
"She had a small robot on the table."
"It was white, and it had a small green light."
"It was awesome, Lily."
"It drew a picture of a tree with one long arm."
"The arm moved to the left and then to the right."
"How old is she?" asked Lily.
"She is young," said Tom, "and she laughs a lot."
"Is she a teacher?" asked Lily.
"No, she is an engineer," said Tom.
"She recently came to Thailand for a school project."
"She does not know our language, but she was able to talk to us in English."
Pip came to Tom and put his head on Tom's bag.
Tom smiled and touched the puppy's head.
"Did she say anything about her school days?" asked Lily.
"Yes," said Tom.
"She built her first robot when she was a teenager."
"She made it from old boxes."
"It was too slow, and it fell on the floor."
"Was it hard?" asked Lily.
"Very hard," said Tom.
"She did not stop, and now she builds robots for hospitals."
Lily listened and held her notebook.
"And then?" asked Lily.
"After that, each of us wrote one idea for a robot," said Tom.
"Ben wrote a robot that cleans the board."
"Hugo wrote a robot that carries bags."
"I wrote a robot that finds socks."
"We stayed in the science room until half past five."
"Then we helped Teacher Nick to carry the chairs."
Lily laughed, and Pip made a small sound.
"I want to become an engineer too," said Tom.
"Come and eat, you two!" called Mom.
"First, I must find my socks," he said.
